label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
changes: fix (regression from 0.1.27): the labelAtlasRows JNI export returned u8 while Kotlin declared Int; on ARM64 the upper bits of the return register are unspecified, so new label atlases were usually treated as not applied and retried every frame, resetting the renderer's labels each frame
labelAtlasRows now returns i32; any result other than 1 falls back to a whole-atlas upload instead of retrying
new NativeSignatureTest: every Kotlin external in NativeBridge must return the JNI type its Rust export returns (fails on 0.1.29)

tests.gpu: label_occlusion, overlay_drape pass on Vulkan and GLES
